tasks.subject: Task 0: Update card template in build-blog.js
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Replace cardHtml() output with a clean linked card: image, category+readtime, title, excerpt.

**Files:**
- Modify: `scripts/build-blog.js` (lines 173-198)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] cardHtml() returns an `<a>` element wrapping the whole card
- [ ] data-category and data-search attributes preserved
- [ ] Card contains: image, .story-meta, .story-title, .story-excerpt
- [ ] npm run build:blog runs without errors

**Verify:** `npm run build:blog` → `Built 6 posts.`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["scripts/build-blog.js"], "verifyCommand": "npm run build:blog", "acceptanceCriteria": ["cardHtml returns <a> wrapper", "data-category and data-search preserved", "build runs without errors"]}
```
